name: West Chester Fall 2022

venue.name: East High School
venue.details: In the cafeteria on the first floor. Go in through the front entrance and follow the signs.

information:
# Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.
# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:
##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, November 26th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
##### **OR** 
##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, December 6th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. 
####
